 The Police-Inspector, Basavanagudi Women Police Station,
Bangalore has filed this chargesheet against the accused for the offence punishable U/s. 498A, 506(B) r/w/s 34 of I.P.C. & Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Case against Accused No.1 is ordered to be splitup and hence trial proceeded against A2 and A3 only.
2.The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. Umashankari.

The gist of the prosecution case is that CW-1 got married with Accused No.1 (splitup) on 22-01-2007 at Sri Manjunathaswamy temple,
Dharmasthala in the presence of elders.

At time of marriage, as per demand made by the accused No.2 and 3, the parents of CW-1 had given Rs.50,000/- cash, gold finger ring and gold neck chain , gold  3  C.C.No.27152/2011 bracelet to accused No.1.
After the marriage, CW-1 started residing with accused persons at Harohalli main road in a rented house and also at Yelahanka Maruthinagar.

During this period the accused persons with common intention used to pick quarrel with CW-1,
abuse her, assaulted her and tortured her.
On 22-03-2011 at 10.30 a.m at the instigation of accused No.1, other accused picked quarrel with CW1, abused her and poured kerosene on her and threatened to light her up.
Further in furtherance of their common intention accused persons subjected CW-1 to cruelty physically and mentally in demand of additional dowry of Rs.Two lakhs.

Based on the said first information of Smt. Umashankari, a case in Crime No.69/2021 came to be registered against the Accused No.1 to 3 for the aforesaid offences.

3. After completion of the investigation, the Sub-Inspector of Police, Basavanagudi Women Police Station, Bangalore has filed this charge sheet against the Accused No.1 to 3 for the offence punishable U/s.498A, 506(B) r/w/s 34 of I.P.C. & Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act..
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took the cognizance of the alleged offence.

Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons Accused entered appearance and were  4  C.C.No.27152/2011 enlarged on bail and the prosecution papers was provided to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge, an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offence was framed and same was read over to the accused No.2 and 3 in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW1 and PW10 witnesses and got marked Ex.P.1 to P-4 documents.
The Statement of Accused as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., was recorded.
The accused denied the incriminating circumstances appearing against him.
The accused have not let in any oral or documentary evidence on their behalf.
6. Heard arguments on both sides.

I have Perused the Umashankari vs G.Balasudramanyam And Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40604287/
3 materials on record.
 7.

The following point arise for my determination :-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that accused No.2 and 3 along with accused No.1  caused physical and mental cruelty to CW-1 in demand  of additional dowry and threatened to kill her and  thereby the accused have committed the offences  5  C.C.No.27152/2011  punishable u/s.498A, 506(B) r/w/s 34 of I.P.C. & Sec.4  of Dowry Prohibition Act..?
 2) What Order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1.......In the Negative.
 Point No.2.......As per final Order, for the following :-

9. POINT No.1:-
It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution will have to establish its case beyond all reasonable doubt.
In order to prove the same, the prosecution has examined 10 witnesses as PW1 to PW10 and ExP.1 to Ex.P.4 documents are marked.

She has deposed in her examination in chief that Accused No.1 is her husband, Accused No.2 is her mother in law and the Accused-3 is her sister in law.
Her marriage with Accused No.1 was performed at Dharmasthala on 22-01-2007.
At the time of marriage Accused No.2 and A3 demanded cash of Rs.50,000/- and gold worth Rs.15,000/- and for her 2 necklace, ear earing, finger ring and same were given as per accused persons demand.

PW.-1 further stated that after marriage she resided with Accused at Harohalli Umashankari vs G.Balasudramanyam And Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40604287/

They have stated that they had not given any statement to the police.

sentences.text: PW-9 Doolappa ASI HAL P.S. has deposed in his examination in chief that he was deputed to trace the Accused No.1 in crime No.108/2011.
Accordingly he and CW-16 went to Star links cable, Boopasandra and apprehended Accused No.1 and produced before CW-18 with report and he gave statement before IO.

Kenchegowda, PI CID, Bangalore in his examination has deposed in his evidence that on 20-06-2011 he took up records of this case, verified the records, as investigation was completed, he submitted chargesheet against Accused.
 19.
The above being the materials on record it would be appropriate to see whether the prosecution proves the guilt of the accused No.2 and 3 beyond reasonable doubt.
20. At this point it has to be stated that the Accused No.1 is not part of this trial as he is absconding and case was split up against him.
This trial and the judgment only concerns the Accused No.2 and 3.
Hence, in this judgment this court would only meet the case of the prosecution which concerns the Accused No.2 and 3  12  C.C.No.27152/2011 only.
This court would not venture into giving its findings in respect of allegations found against the Accused No.1 in the evidence.
21 . In this case the marriage of Accused No.1 and the CW1 is an admitted fact.

In the entire evidence it has come on record that the marriage of CW1 and Accused No.1 was conducted in a simple Umashankari vs G.Balasudramanyam And Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40604287/
9 manner at Dharmasthala.
Hence, the contention of the prosecution that there was a demand of dowry at the time of marriage is by itself in doubt.
22. Now coming to the demand of dowry during the marriage talks is concerned it is come in evidence that the grandmother of the CW1 was the person in whose presence marriage talks took place.
It has also come in evidence that she is still alive.

However,
she is not arrayed as witness in this case.
It has to be stated that she was the best evidence to prove this aspect.
However, the prosecution has failed to produce the best evidence to the court.
This itself casts doubts regarding the demand of dowry by the accused at the time of the marriage.
23. It is the case of the prosecution that the Accused No.1 to 3 had subjected the CW1 to mental and physical harassment in  13  C.C.No.27152/2011 respect of demand of dowry.

It has to be stated at this stage that the in the cross examination of witnesses it has come on record that the CW1 and Accused No.1 resided with the Accused No.2 and 3 only for a maximum period of 2 months and later they shifted separately to Maruthi Nagar.
PW4 mother of the PW1 has deposed that the Accused never troubled CW1 while she was residing with them and they never troubled CW1 when she was residing separately with her husband.
This clearly demonstrates that the Accused No.2 and 3 never harassed CW1 as claimed by the prosecution.

Umashankari vs G.Balasudramanyam And Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40604287/
10  24.

It is interesting to note that there is delay in filing of the complaint in respect of the incident dated 23-03-2011 wherein the PW1 has deposed that she was tried to be killed by setting her on fire.
However, PW1 during her cross examination has deposed that she had not given any complaint on that day or any subsequent day.
This complaint is given about 3 months after the alleged incident.
There is no explanation as to why complaint is lodge with such a huge delay.
Hence, this unexplained delay also casts doubt regarding the incident.
Other than the close family members of the complainant no other person has been examined to prove the prosecution case.
The two independent witnesses who were examined by the prosecution being PW6 and 7 have turned hostile to the case of the prosecution.

It is true that mere the witnesses being close relatives their evidence cannot be totally brushed aside but it is also an settle position of law that when all the witnesses are close relatives they evidence has to be closely scrutinized before relying on the same.
In this case I have gone through the entire evidence of family members of CW1.
The entire allegations mainly concentrate on the treatment meted out to the CW1 by the Accused No.1.
The only allegations made against the Accused No.2 and 3 are bald allegations which have no legs to stand.
Mere making bald allegations without proper substantiation of the allegations is no proof of the allegation in the eyes of law.
Mere on the bald allegations this court cannot convict the accused No.2 and 3.

Umashankari vs G.Balasudramanyam And Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40604287/
11

Further the allegations made in the entire evidence of prosecution witnesses against the Accused No.2 and 3 do not fit into the definition of cruelty as mentioned in definition of cruelty as per Sec.498-A of IPC.
Hence, this court holds that prosecution has failed to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
15  C.C.No.27152/2011  Accordingly I answer point No.1 in the Negative.

26. POINT No.2:- In the result, I proceed to pass the following:-
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred U/s.248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused No.2 and 3 are acquitted of the offence punishable U/s.498A, 506(B) r/w/s 34 of I.P.C. & Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bond and surety bonds executed by the accused No.2 and 3 shall remain in force for 6 months.
Office is hereby directed to preserve the records and property if any as case against Accused No.1 is splitup.
